Usage: astryx component [options] [names...]

List components or print component docs

Arguments:
  names                  One or more exact selectors. Use Name, package/Name, @scope/package/Name, or @scope/package@version/Name. Two or more return one ordered batch. At most 100 selectors are accepted.

Options:
  --list                 List every component (the same as giving no name)
  --category <category>  List one component group, e.g. --category Layout or --category Avatar (an unknown group lists the valid ones)
  --props                Print only the props table
  --source               Print component source code
  --showcase             Print showcase source code
  --blocks               List example blocks: showcase, examples, and related
  --package <name>       Scope lookup to an external package (e.g. @acme/xds-widgets). Use @astryxdesign/core to select an original replaced by an integration component.
  -h, --help             display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  unknown component, category, or package; more than 100 selectors; any batch row is unresolved; or @astryxdesign/core cannot be resolved

Examples:
  # Browse the catalog
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component --list
  # Look up several components
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Button Badge Text
  # Props table as JSON
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Button --props --json
  # Select a replaced Core original
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component SideNav --package @astryxdesign/core

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/component
